lines.t: Corrigendum to Council Regulation (EU) 2022/394 of 9 March 2022 amending Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of Russia’s actions destabilising the situation in Ukraine
( Official Journal of the European Union L 81 of 9 March 2022 )
On page 3, in Article 1, in the amendments to Regulation (EU) No 833/2014, points (7) and (8):
Annex VI is amended is accordance with Annex I to this Regulation;
Annex IX is amended is accordance with Annex II to this Regulation;’,
Annex VII is amended in accordance with Annex I to this Regulation;
Annex IX is amended in accordance with Annex II to this Regulation;’.
